consequence.statement: Any endpoint.tls.caOptional configuration present in ConsulCatalog or Nomad provider static configuration will be ignored in v3.
consequence.remediation: Remove the endpoint.tls.caOptional option from the ConsulCatalog and Nomad provider static configuration sections.

assertion.statement: The ConsulCatalog provider endpoint.tls.caOptional option and the Nomad provider endpoint.tls.caOptional option have been removed in v3.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the change clusters two providers (ConsulCatalog and Nomad), each with its own endpoint.tls.caOptional configuration path; they must be answered separately per the rule against bundling distinct changes; applicability: the static configuration keys for provider options are not directly queryable via the canonical applicability operators; determining exposure requires knowing which providers are configured and contain this option, which depends on the environment's actual static configuration that is not provided
